guidetextdraw._value:
Fee Information: A $10 verification fee will be charged for each verification form requested on your Student Homepage. Student has two weeks to pay the fee before a hold is placed on their record.

Former Students: Must pay online upon request by Student Business Services.

Current Students: Student Business Services will post the charge to your student account. Allow 3 to 5 working days for processing.
